visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). There is no index.html in this directory. The visual target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
note: Homes grain fix 2026-08-14. Rhythm: THREE of the six patterns, no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb, Field of the cut houses (count is a caption, never an Instrument hero), Sheet, Quiet, Footer. The empty window substitutes a Quiet for the Field and is still three patterns. Every figure comes from ONE getPriceDrops({ limit: 48, days: 7 }) call. Absent is not zero: an empty resilient-cache fallback is opted out of ISR with noStore(), and Dataset / updated / count figures are omitted rather than published as 0. Drop math is previous list price to current list price. Field rows sort by lastDropPct descending. HideAwareListingGrid is a declared deletion: hidden-home subtraction stays on /search.
deletions: KbHero: the dark photo hero and its live-glance counts. The counts survive as Instrument figures when the pull is non-empty.
KbFeatured: the poster grid of the biggest percent reductions. Those homes are Field rows now, sorted by lastDropPct descending.
KbListingMap: replaced by the Field's built-in plot of rows that carry coordinates.

HideAwareListingGrid: the per-user hidden-aware ListingCard grid (W7.2). Hidden-home subtraction stays on /search. This page is a curated 7-day cut list, not a browse of for-sale inventory, and it does not import a raw listing renderer.
Neighborhood mini-table: the 7-day pull grouped by subdivision. Field row meta still names displaySubdivision when the feed has a readable name.
City chip sections: the filter-nav and every-city chip rows. City doors live in the closing Quiet.
KbCommunityAlerts markup: replaced by PriceDropAlertsSheet on V3Sheet. Capture contract unchanged (see dataLayer), including the company honeypot.
KbSell: the seller band. Seller ask lives on Sell. The house is the primary on this buyer Field.
CTABar: the closing talk-to-a-broker bar. Not carried.
V3Instrument number hero: 60 / $3.2M / 5.6% and the method essay. Count is a caption beside the Field.
DisplayHeading / PageBreadcrumb hidden parity hacks on the city route.
SmoothScrollProvider: the Lenis wrapper. The v3 register does not hijack scroll.
KbFooter and KbBreadcrumb: replaced by V3Footer and V3Breadcrumb.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + Dataset + webPage JSON-LD when the window is non-empty. Dataset is omitted on an empty pull so a now() fallback cannot stamp freshness. Required by ci:ai-structured-data for this route by name (MetadataBlock + getPriceDrops).

requiredComponents.name: V3Field
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 2, once, opens the page. Photographed cut houses. Count is a caption of the Field population, never a number hero. Rows without a street or a list price are dropped. Sorted by drop percent.

requiredComponents.name: PriceDropAlertsSheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, once, in app/price-drops/_v3/PriceDropAlertsSheet.client.tsx. Wraps V3Sheet. Capture contract unchanged (see dataLayer).

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6. Closing edges (window, homes for sale, open houses, city doors). Also the empty-window H1 branch, where it replaces Field.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (breadcrumb entry): Home, Price drops

MetadataBlock schemas array (dataset entry) ONLY when total > 0. Variables: Price reductions (7-day window), Total asking-price cuts when > 0, Median drop when not null. dateModified is the pull's fetchedAt, never a now() fallback.
MetadataBlock schemas array, only when total > 0, description carries the live count.

dataLayer.getPriceDrops: lib/data/listings/getPriceDrops.ts. { limit: 48, days: 7 }. No .catch() empty swallow. Empty result calls noStore() so ISR cannot pin a blank week. THE ONLY READ ON THIS PAGE.
dataLayer.submitSearchAlertSignup: app/actions/search-alert-capture.ts, bound to PriceDropAlertsSheet. UNCHANGED CONTRACT: { email, filters: { propertyType: 'A' } (region) or { city } (city page), company }.
dataLayer.note: Route-local constants and Field/JSON-LD builders live in app/price-drops/_v3/ so the route file stays under the ci:file-size-budget floor.

sectionOrder: PriceDropsOpening -- the H1 and the count of homes that cut price
V3Field #cuts -- the reduced homes, each a door
V3SourceLine -- the trace and the stamp under the set
V3Quiet #answer -- what a price cut means here, in text, for the query
PriceDropAlertsSheet -- the ask: tell me when a home cuts price
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow's and Redfin's price-cut filters on a page a search engine can actually rank. Their reductions live behind a filter state with no indexable URL; this is a standing page for 'price reductions bend oregon' and 'price drops central oregon' that publishes the cut homes themselves, each one a door, with the source trace and the refresh stamp under the set. The answer -- how many homes cut price and by how much -- is in text, not only in the list.
